description: Microsoft kicked 2026 off with a new Xbox Developer Direct showcase, which featured some of the biggest games it has coming out this year. This time taking us to Tokyo, Forza Horizon 6 will let players build custom garages where you can invite friends over to hangout and show off your sick lineup. Lastly there's Beast of Reincarnation. author: IGN
description: Sovereign Tower has an entertaining concept that draws its characters and dialogue equally from fantastical tradition and modern life. Couple that with a deliciously detailed art style and a sense of what's most entertaining to do in both management games and visual novels and that's enough to sell it, we think, but it also has some nice surprises and a weird little twist on the genre as a whole. We had a pretty darn good time with it, and I'm looking forward to more. Previewed by Jon Bolding.
title: Sovereign Tower Preview: Hands-On With This Unique Arthurian Round Table Management RPG

Check out a graphics comparison of Final Fantasy 7 Remake Intergrade on the Nintendo Switch 2 vs the PlayStation 5 in performance mode.

description:
Start out as a helpless naked spirit, then make yourself a body on the pottery wheel and compete in bizarre competitions while carrying water to put out the fire in the enemies kiln! description:
Microsoft is ready to showcase their upcoming suite of 2026 and beyond games. With looks at the highly anticipated entry into the Fable franchise, Game Freak's Beast of Incarnation, and Forza Horizon 6, the show is already shaping up to be a big one. At roughly an hour long, the Xbox Developer Direct is sure to be host to a slew of many more games as well. Recently, Xbox tweeted that 2026 is a big year for games with a "6" in the title. Could they just be referring to Forza Horizon 6 and the impending GTA 6 launch, or could the swirling rumors of a shadow drop for Elder Scrolls 6 have some Merritt? Either way, IGN will be right there in the action. Tune in on Thursday January 22nd, 2026 at 10am, then stick around after Microsoft's show ends for an in-depth analysis on everything show off with IGN's Unlocked crew.
